therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of chronic low-grade inflammation to improve insulin sensitivity and beta-cell function
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in HbA1c at 12 weeks

results.effect_size: LS Mean differences vs placebo: -0.274% (0.6 mg), -0.378% (18 mg), -0.245% (180 mg)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional increases in serum Cmax and AUCτ,SS confirmed systemic exposure across dose levels
biomarker_changes: Fasting glucose LS mean change: -0.873 mmol/L (0.6 mg), -1.270 mmol/L (18 mg), -0.629 mmol/L (180 mg), -0.019 mmol/L (placebo)
Fasting insulin LS mean change: -1.589 μIU/L (0.6 mg), -0.918 μIU/L (18 mg), -0.229 μIU/L (180 mg), +1.405 μIU/L (placebo)
MMTT glucose at 2 hours: 22 participants (0.6 mg), 17 (18 mg), 18 (180 mg), 24 (placebo) had measurable change
MMTT insulin at 2 hours: 22 participants (0.6 mg), 17 (18 mg), 18 (180 mg), 24 (placebo) had measurable change
safety_signals: Serious adverse events reported: chest pain (18 mg, n=1), migraine (0.6 mg, n=1), asthma (18 mg, n=1), status asthmaticus (18 mg, n=1)

dose_info.schedule: twice weekly subcutaneous injection for 12 weeks
